notes.title: Update for Steam Deck compatibility!
notes.content: I recently was (finally) able to afford a Steam Deck and I could properly test and update this game so it runs butter smooth on it. Mostly, it was changing some stuff around so the screen's resolution didn't clip off the edges of the game. Now I gotta talk with Valve and get it verified.

notes.title: Small update (v20240111-01)
notes.content:
Very small update to the game based off feedback from a Steam player (thank you!):


 End screen at Death Inc. now displays the proper end screen if you have all 50 gold stars (sometimes it didn't)
 Bug relating to the blue ghosts where they would sometimes be treated as angels instead of neutral

notes.title: Update notes for June 15th
notes.content: I've gotten a few comments on Linux builds that Steam isn't recognizing the achievements. I have switched to a different Steamworks library and I believe they are working as expected now. Please reach out if you run into problems on any OS and I'm happy to help! :)

notes.title: Death Drives A Bus update (v2.3.4)
notes.content:
Kind of a minor update, but I put in a fix for some windowed mode users so the screen doesn't go BANANAS. I also made windowed mode a little bit bigger.

I also included my name on the main menu from a really cool and interesting GDC talk I watched.

Thanks for playing <3

notes.title: Death Drives A Bus v2.3 Update
notes.content:
​I've gotten a bit of feedback from people over the past week. In the process of updating the game, I created a neat automated system to build and deploy the game automatically to Steam and itch as well! So that's definitely a win :)

v2.3 updates

 Resetting the game now clears the spirit card as well
 When you deliver spirits to the last portal on the map, but spirits still exist on the map, you game over (no more weird soft locks)
 Windowed mode functions a bit better now and doesn't crop off the game on wide monitors
 Added more context-sensitive prompts for keyboard/controller support
 A few really minor tweaks I probably forgot about


​I know I keep saying it, but this will likely be the last update for a while. I've got some more projects in the works that are really exciting. Right now it's using "developer art", which is to say it's not pretty to look at. I'm hoping to fix that up and get something ready for people to play in a few weeks. Thank you for all your support and kind words on this game! Feel free to get in touch with bug reports and game suggestions. I can always add it to the list next time I poke at it :)

notes.title: Death Drives A Bus update!
notes.content:
Hello friends! A few post-launch updates that I wanted to share with you all! Thanks so much for your support with this game! I'm so pleased with the reception it's gotten over the past week.

v2.2 updates:

 Linux and Mac builds shouldn't crash on load now (see below)
 Had some requests to include windowed mode so put that option in the main menu.
 Discovered some issues with the controller prompts where the confirm and cancel buttons were swapped.
 Added a prompt to back out of the credits and tutorial pages.


OK, so related to Linux and Mac builds. Apparently the library I'm using to connect to Steam is having some issues with certain Linux and Mac builds. I'm working on finding a fix for that, but the current workaround is that if it tries to connect and fails, it just falls back to local save data. This unfortunately means that you won't have cloud saves for the moment, but I'll keep an eye on the library's development and hopefully can push another fix up in the future.
